If you want a **donor CRM with built-in text messaging**, **DonorPerfect**, **Andar/360**, and **DonorDock** are all relevant options, and DonorPerfect also supports SMS through native and integrated tools.[3][4][5][6]

- **DonorPerfect** offers **DP Text**, a bi-directional SMS integration that supports donor texting, text-to-give, volunteer signups, segmentation, and automated follow-up.[3]
- DonorPerfect also supports **Constant Contact SMS** as a texting add-on, with features like group texts, automated messages, opt-in forms, link tracking, and donation links.[4]
- **Andar/360** includes a texting module for personalized messages, response tracking, automated follow-ups, and opt-in/opt-out handling.[5]
- **DonorDock** supports individual and bulk donor texts for reminders, appeals, thank-yous, and real-time engagement.[6]
- For **texting focused on stewardship and engagement**, Bloomergang’s guidance emphasizes that SMS is especially useful for donor follow-up and relationship-building, not just fundraising.[2]

- recommendations for **small nonprofits vs. larger fundraising teams**
